problem.statement: Client, partner, captain and field actors need one authenticated and operator-context-isolated read-only view of their WLT-owned wallet, balances and ledger references through DSH BFF, while finance operators need permission-scoped lookup without transferring financial ownership to DSH or any frontend.
problem.currentWorkaround: Representative finance was fragmented across surfaces, runtime Identity subjects did not align with WLT seed actors, and wallet and ledger reads did not carry an authenticated operator context boundary.

actors.role: Authenticated customer reading only their own operator-context-bound wallet and ledger references
permittedActions: read own available pending and held balances

actors.role: Authenticated partner reading only their own operator-context-bound wallet and reference finance
permittedActions: read own settlements commissions and payouts

actors.role: Authenticated captain reading their operator-context-bound wallet, earnings references, payouts and COD liability
Authenticated field actor reading their operator-context-bound wallet, commissions, ledger and payout requests
permittedActions: read and submit own payout requests

actors.role: Permission-scoped finance operator reading representative wallets and ledger references inside the operator context resolved by Identity
permittedActions: lookup a supported actor wallet in own operator context
filter ledger by actor in own operator context
inspect reference commissions settlements and payouts
forbiddenActions: supply or override operator context id
read another operator context wallet or ledger
use read permission for a money-moving action
treat DSH as financial truth owner

routesOrScreens: field finance wallet commissions ledger and payouts
WLT operator-context-bound wallet and ledger reads

outcome.statement: Every representative sees an authenticated operator-context-bound WLT-owned wallet and permission-scoped ledger view through DSH, while operators can inspect supported wallets and matching ledgers only inside their Identity operator context without any DSH or frontend balance mutation path.
outcome.primaryMetric: operator context and actor scoped wallet and ledger read coverage across required surfaces
guardrailMetrics: frontend direct WLT financial read count
DSH wallet balance mutation path count
outcome.baselineState: Wallet capability was fragmented, route bindings were inconsistent, runtime actor seeds did not align and representative finance lacked a trusted operator context boundary.
outcome.targetState: All four actor surfaces use canonical identity and operator context-scoped DSH reads and the control panel uses finance.read-scoped same-operator context DSH lookups backed by WLT truth.
outcome.observationWindow: targeted contract, migration, backend, frontend, runtime, finance-control and independent acceptance verification

criteria: WLT accepts only client partner captain and field wallet actor types.
DSH derives self-service actor identity and operator context from the authenticated session and never from a frontend query body path or operator context header.
Client partner captain and field have canonical own-wallet and own-ledger routes.
The control panel wallet and ledger lookup requires finance.read and uses the operator operator context resolved by Identity.
WLT wallet and ledger repositories filter by operator context before actor type and actor id.
cross-operator-context wallet lookup is hidden as not found and cross-operator-context ledger lookup returns no entries.
Available pending held earned settled and paid balances are rendered from WLT without local derivation.
Ledger entries are operator context and actor scoped before forwarding to WLT.
Partner wallet UI does not use settlement pending amount as available wallet balance and contains no hardcoded actor fallback.
Field payout requests remain idempotent and cannot exceed the loaded available balance in the UI.
No DSH or frontend route writes wallet balances or appends ledger truth for this journey.
Loading empty partial forbidden offline error and retry states are represented on required human-facing surfaces.
Correlation and no-store response controls are applied to representative finance reads.
requiredChecks: WLT operator context wallet repository tests
DSH finance proxy operator context propagation tests
DSH actor operator context route and scoping tests

business: WLT is the sole owner of wallet and ledger truth.
DSH is an authenticated and authorized BFF only.
Every representative finance read is scoped to the operator context resolved by Identity.
Every self-service wallet read is scoped to the resolved actor.
A wallet actor identity is globally unique and every read remains operator context bound.
Ledger history is append-only financial evidence.
negative: No DSH table or handler mutates representative wallet balances.
No frontend calls internal WLT financial routes directly.
No user-facing surface supplies an arbitrary self-service actor id or operator context id.
No operator lookup crosses the Identity operator context boundary.
No settlement summary is labeled as a wallet balance.
No read permission authorizes a money-moving action.

owners.productOwner: WLT Wallet and Ledger Product Owner

execution.appetite: Close actor- and context-scoped wallet, ledger, route, UI, runtime, and financial-boundary gaps without enabling unapproved money movement or production deployment.
fixedConstraints: The authorized work branch is validclean.
Platform context comes only from authenticated Identity.
No PR merge, force push, release, or production deployment is authorized.
Independent financial and product approvals cannot be self-issued by engineering.
